sentence: The same pattern of \"looks fixed, isn't\" shows up outside birthstones, too: [Virgo's date range](/virgo-dates/) can shift by a day between years and local time zones as the Sun’s entry into the sign falls at a different instant.

It's been edited in pieces by a handful of trade groups over more than a century, the same way plenty of claims repeated as settled fact online, like [National Dog Day's founding story](/national-dog-day/), require checking what each account establishes.
